# Fastino Labs

> Docs for building, fine-tuning, evaluating, and deploying models with Fastino.

> ## Agent instructions
> Use https://docs.fastino.ai/openapi.json as the source of truth for customer-facing Fastino API routes. Only call operations present in that specification. Do not infer or call undocumented routes. Direct Fastino API integrations use https://api.fastino.ai, `/v1` routes, and `FASTINO_API_KEY`.

## Get started

- [Introduction](https://docs.fastino.ai/introduction.md): Learn how Fastino provides training and inference for specialized models.
- [Fastino quickstart](https://docs.fastino.ai/quickstart.md): Create a Fastino API key and run your first inference or training request.
- [Fastino GLiNER agent skill](https://docs.fastino.ai/concepts/gliner-agent-skill.md): Install Fastino's hosted GLiNER skill for your coding agent.
- [Example use cases](https://docs.fastino.ai/example-use-cases.md): Explore GLiNER use cases for extraction, routing, retrieval, and safety workflows.

## Models

- [GLiNER](https://docs.fastino.ai/concepts/gliner.md): Compare GLiNER2.5, GLiNER2, and GLiNER for efficient information extraction.
- [GLiNER-2.5-Decide](https://docs.fastino.ai/concepts/gliner-2-5-decide.md): Use typed decisions, constraints, extraction, relations, and structured records for low-latency decision-making.
- [Model catalog](https://docs.fastino.ai/concepts/models.md): Browse Fastino models and their model IDs.

## APIs

- [Inference API](https://docs.fastino.ai/inference.md): Run schema-based GLiNER predictions through Fastino's inference API.
- [Training API](https://docs.fastino.ai/training.md): Create and manage Fastino training jobs from submission through artifact delivery.
- [OpenAPI specification](https://docs.fastino.ai/openapi.json): Read the authoritative customer-facing request, response, authentication, and route contracts.

## Account

- [Trust and safety](https://docs.fastino.ai/trust-safety.md): Learn how Fastino protects data and secures its infrastructure.
